record.field: Creates a new CRM Lead/Opportunity from the message. Use this when the user expresses interest in a service or product.
Creates a new Project or converts an existing Lead to a Project. Use this when the work is confirmed or a deposit is made.
Creates a Task in an existing Project. Use this for support requests, bug reports, or new requirements on ongoing work.
Sends a WhatsApp reply to the user. Use this when no other specific action (Lead/Project/Task) is needed, or to ask clarifying questions.
Checks the status of the user's most recent project and sends them a summary.
